remarks: Welcome to 25 Cherry Lane ~ This charming 3 bedroom, 2 1/2 bathroom expanded ranch is filled with timeless appeal. Old-world charm greets you the moment you step inside the beautifully appointed living room with a wood burning fireplace creating a cozy and welcoming gathering space. The gourmet eat-in kitchen with vaulted ceiling is bathed in natural light and is truly the heart of the home with its welcoming design that makes cooking and entertaining a joy. The loft is ideal for a home office, reading nook, or creative space tailored to your lifestyle. Additionally, the family room and dining room both with built-ins complete this rare opportunity in South Wilton. Thoughtful details and tasteful finishes throughout plus easy one floor living makes this home move in ready. This property also offers an exceptional opportunity for gardening enthusiasts. It features a fully fenced-in garden creating an optimal environment for nurturing a wide range of plants, making it the perfect spot for anyone who enjoys spending time outdoors and tending to their garden. HIGHEST AND BEST DUE MONDAY MARCH 2ND AT 6 PM.
